# Departments
The Unique Identification Authority of India operates through its Head Office in New Delhi and eight Regional Offices, supported by Data Centres in Bengaluru and Manesar. Its departments, led by DDGs and officers, ensure efficient governance, operations, and delivery of Aadhaar services.
